sections.title: Mechanics
items: Player Safe: Players can inspect, handle, keep, trade, reveal, or earn Tinker's Kit, Used when it is present in the fiction.
Gm Only: Use the roll only when the player's method, stakes, and consequence are concrete.

No Roll Reveals: Surface read: Advantage on Finesse rolls to pick locks, disarm simple traps, or jury-rig. Give obvious visible facts freely; roll for meaning, risk, leverage, cost, or a hidden angle.
